caption: The drawing depicts a park-like landscape with a group of brown and green trees dominating the central and upper part of the composition. Behind the trees, there are several white buildings with rectangular windows scattered across the background. In the foreground near the center, there are two human figures sitting at a round table; one is leaning over the table, while the other is sitting on the opposite side. Both figures have blue clothing. To the right, there are two more figures sitting together on a bench, both reading or looking at papers; one is wearing blue and the other brown, and there is a child sitting nearby on the ground. The lower portion of the drawing features a body of water with three small boats: two contain people and one is empty. On the left side, adjacent to the water, there is a two-story yellowish building with a dark brown roof. The overall color palette consists mainly of muted browns, greens, blues, and yellows, with details throughout suggesting vegetation, structures, and water. The entire composition is framed by a simple, light-colored border.
title: Sampler
